recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Everything Bagels
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet.
Mix the cottage cheese, flour, baking powder and salt to a thick dough, dusting with flour if sticky.
Divide into 4, roll each into a rope and join the ends into a ring.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle generously with seasoning.
Bake 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool 5–10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate.
